cohort: Primiparous women who underwent vaginal birth or caesarean section without complaints of VL during pregnancy were included.
finding: The prevalence of VL in primiparous women was 8% and was associated with the occurrence of vaginal symptoms, urgency urinary incontinence (UUI), and coital incontinence six months postpartum.
cross-section timing: Data was collected at recruitment and six-months postpartum, within a study period between July 2021 and January 2023.
